newsitem.title: USA: American Medserve buys pharmacy operation.
newsitem.headline: American Medserve buys pharmacy operation.

text.p: American Medserve Corp said Tuesday its Sterling Healthcare Services unit acquired Institutional Pharmacy Services and its related businesses for an undisclosed price.

American Medserve said Institutional Pharmacy Services provides pharmacy, prescription medical supplies and other services to 1,200 residents of long-term care facilities in Louisiana, posting annual revenues of about $3 million.
American Medserve is an independent provider of pharmaceutical care to 47,700 residents of more than 640 long-term care and assisted living facilities in 10 states.
Its shares were up 3/8 Tuesday at 11-1/2.
